hypothesis: Displayed liquidity changes on Binance Futures can distinguish whether a completed Bybit dealing-range boundary raid is genuine accepted delivery or a rejected liquidity sweep before Bybit alone reveals the final draw on liquidity.

explainable_translation.external_liquidity: The immediately preceding completed Bybit five-minute high and low.
explainable_translation.sweep: The first one-sided trade through exactly one frozen boundary in the next five-minute block.
explainable_translation.confirmation_time: One entire post-raid second must close before the model decision; the first executable Bybit quote is at least 100 ms later.
explainable_translation.acceptance: Continuation toward a fixed half-range extension before the untouched opposite boundary.
explainable_translation.rejection: Reversal toward the untouched opposite boundary before the same-side half-range extension.
explainable_translation.ml_role: One model estimates which of the two structural liquidity objectives is reached first; cost-adjusted expected value may select continuation, reversal, or flat.

data_contract.development_download_condition: all fit confirmation gates pass without changing any dependency

features: direction-normalized Binance minus Bybit one-second return gap
Bybit sweep depth divided by prior range
Bybit decision position/reclaim divided by prior range
model_contract.baseline: Exact competing-barrier distance probability computed from the executable entry midpoint.
model_contract.action_rule: Choose the larger of continuation and reversal expected values only when it exceeds the 24-bp contract by an additional fixed 5 bp; otherwise remain flat.

structural_payoff.continuation_target: raided boundary plus or minus 0.50 of the prior dealing range
structural_payoff.same_timestamp_double_barrier: ambiguous event excluded before model fitting

execution_account.top_winner_removal: Remove the largest 10 percent of positive event PnL and rerun global-slot arbitration from initial NAV.

promotion_boundary: This sparse first-day pre-2024 screen is not rank eligible. A survivor must expand unchanged across all remaining pre-2024 source partitions and then receive exact Bybit funding, liquidation-distance, capacity and continuous account replay before official 2024 can open.
